description: This file contains service functions for handling notification operations in a railway ticket booking system, including creating notifications, listing notifications for a user, and marking notifications as read.

methods.name: Notification create_notification(db: Session, user_id: int, title: str, message: str, type_: NotificationType = NotificationType.info)
methods.description: Creates a new notification record in the database for a specific user.

methods.name: List[Notification] list_notifications(db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notifications for a specific user, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: int mark_notifications_read(db: Session, user_id: int, ids: list[int] | None = None)
methods.description: Marks specified notifications or all notifications as read for a given user.

ctags.name: create_notification
ctags.pattern: /^def create_notification(db: Session, user_id: int, title: str, message: str, type_: Notification/
ctags.signature: (db: Session, user_id: int, title: str, message: str, type_: NotificationType = NotificationType.info)

ctags.name: mark_notifications_read
ctags.pattern: /^def mark_notifications_read(db: Session, user_id: int, ids: list[int] | None = None) -> int:$/
ctags.signature: (db: Session, user_id: int, ids: list[int] | None = None)
